content:
Rumors have long suggested that Apple has been working on a major overhaul of its Home lineup, and the latest leak details some products worth looking forward to.

macOS Code Leak Mentions Several Unreleased Home Devices

Apple's biggest launch event of the year is just weeks away. As expected, new Home products are rumored to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, all-new Apple Watch models, and more.

New Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are rumored to be on the way. But there are also several other Home products that could launch in the near future.

Yesterday, MacRumors discovered references to several unreleased products in the newly released macOS 26.7 RC.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. Juli Clover notes:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be a version of the home hub with a dock, while J491 is a wall-mounted version."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini's codename is B520, so this is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): This is most likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly appearing codenames for unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: The next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub. It's unclear whether their codenames appear in the macOS 26.7 leak.

In addition to products, MacRumors also discovered a string called "Pebble," believed to be the codename for homeOS. There was also a string called "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning," which may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, four color options were found for an unspecified Home accessory: rose pink, silver, space gray, and starlight.
